scope: One bounded task-relevance, feature-content and state-sufficiency diagnosis. C reused development, never blind acceptance. Preserve all prior labels/models/results.

geometry_audit.visibility: Current RGB colour region pixels and both-camera visibility, not a claim of metric depth or hidden-corner visibility.
geometry_audit.closure: Use real existing calls and 9 deterministic matched reset extensions; unexecuted windows are not labelled as would-close.

close_extension.selection: Existing fixtures replicate0, all3colours in A/B/C
close_extension.skill: one frozen Close per reset; max900controls plus127settle and96posthold

probes.input_population: 630 existing new-semantics windows,3 object queries each; labels only targets_v2_1 valid In
probes.model: weighted linear ridge classifier on AB-standardized features, target -1/+1, intercept; feature-normalized kernel X X^T/d; ridge 0.1; threshold0
probes.weight: equal roots then equal label class mass within split train; root-class absent receives no fabricated samples
probes.normalization: AB weighted means and standard deviations only, drop features with std<1e-6
probes.budget: one closed-form fit per5 feature definitions, no seed/hyperparameter search, no D, no network download, CPU
probes.frozen_latent: existing initial query model encoder, includes causal history/proprio; raw visual probes current-frame only; not an architecture fairness claim
probes.patch: Use already cached local2x2 object ROI and global4x4 DINO patch features; no new backbone
probes.geometry: RGB bbox positions are image-space only; no RGBD/calibration saved. GT signed cavity clearances, floor, support, held form a privileged diagnostic bound and must never enter deployable reader.

Close_state_diagnostic.single_relation: AboveRim(x,drawer): drawer-associated object highest corner exceeds cavity top by >2mm at Close start. Report continuous mm and sensitivity as diagnostic; no learned rule deployment.
Close_state_diagnostic.association: GT upward support path for audit only
Close_state_diagnostic.also_report: full clearance, contact start/peak and post-contact displacement; same relation/same9 conflicts that remain

termination: Finish these audits/probes/9calls and report minimum next experiment. No production model repair, newD, controller modification or tuning loops.
